card.name: Plural-pointing words before a noun
card.fires_on: Words like our, these, both, two, first or important that come right before a plural noun, often after 'one of' or 'when the'. The next word is expected to be a plural such as drugs, cases or goals.

modes.label: After 'one of'
modes.description: A determiner or adjective after 'One of' or 'each of', setting up a plural noun.
modes.example: “One of<< our>> goals is to empower people.

modes.label: The two/both drugs
modes.description: A count word before 'drugs' in discussions of two medicines given together.
modes.example: caution should be observed if the<< two>> drugs are to be given concomit

card.writes: It favors plural nouns like instances, courses and examples next, and disfavors singular nouns like thing or item.
card.plain: It fires on a small word that signals a plural noun is coming, such as 'the two' before 'drugs'.
